newsitem.title: USA: Loews stake cut by Tisch brothers.
newsitem.headline: Loews stake cut by Tisch brothers.

text.p: Loews Corp's co-chairmen brothers Lawrence and Preston Tisch said Monday they cut their combined stake in Loews Corp to 36,119,996 common shares or 31.4 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the brothers said their latest transaction includes the sale of 239,600 common between February 14 and February 26 at prices ranging from $102.50 to $106.875 per share.

New York-based Loews is a diversified corporation that operates the fourth-largest U.S. tobacco company, owns 84 percent of CNA Financial Corp and is engaged in the operation of hotels, oil and gas drilling rigs and the sale of watches.
